dns_chain.note: Bucket resolves to standard AWS S3 anycast IPs. No CNAME from any program-owned domain points to this bucket (would have surfaced in Wayback check B). Per spec, bucket DNS is inconclusive by construction since anyone can register a bucket name.

notes: The 'mercadolivre' bucket (typo of 'mercadolibre', lib->liv) appears NOT owned by MercadoLibre. Despite checking 3 representative in-scope program domains (mercadolibre.com.ar, mercadolivre.com.br, mercadopago.com) via Wayback+OTX (1037 archived URLs scanned, zero references to the bucket) and a public GitHub code search (zero hits anywhere on GitHub), there is no evidence linking the bucket to MELI. Note that *.mercadolivre.com.br IS in scope (Tier 1) for MELI Brazil — but no page on that domain or any sibling has ever referenced this bucket per public archives. This matches the README's historical incident: the typo'd bucket was incorrectly attributed and wasted a day. DO NOT draft against this asset.
